observed_architecture.server_transport: HTTPS external ingress with internal container transport subject to template review

required_changes_or_decisions: replace the moving gallery alias with an immutable reviewed source commit or vendored copy
prove the committed file manifest matches the successful preflight download
pin the Azure MCP server container image by digest
decide whether subscription Reader is necessary or whether resource-group or resource scope is supported
review and rename or constrain the Mcp.Tools.ReadWrite scope if its semantics are broader than the admitted read-only tool set
enumerate and approve every preauthorized client application
review TLS termination, forwarded headers, public ingress, DNS, outbound egress, and authentication metadata
define provider-registration, resource creation, RBAC, Entra, rollback, cleanup, monitoring, and cost authorities separately

failure_and_cleanup.repository_rollback: close or revert the repository-only review change
failure_and_cleanup.Azure_rollback: not applicable because this contract performs no Azure mutation
failure_and_cleanup.future_cleanup_warning: azd down does not remove the template-created Entra app registrations; those require separately authorized deletion
